{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the channels
channels = df['channel'].unique()

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
# QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
# Refunded orders: status = 'refunded'
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Combine filters: keep only completed orders that are not QA
valid_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)

# Extract valid orders
df_valid = df[valid_mask].copy()

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
df_valid['revenue'] = df_valid['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = df_valid.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending and get the top channel
top_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]

# Print results
print(channel_revenue)
print(f"Top channel: {top_channel['channel']} with revenue: {top_channel['revenue']:.2f}")"}
